title: Probability of Spin Down
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly compute the probability of finding the electron with spin down as P_down = 2/3.

title: Probability per Solid Angle
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the probability per unit solid angle P(theta, phi) = 1/(4pi).

title: Effective Magnetic Moment (Weak Field)
description: Important Criteria: The student should calculate the effective magnetic moment in the weak magnetic field as mu = e*hbar/(6mc).

title: Final State Quantum Numbers
description: Important Criteria: The student must identify the correct quantum numbers for the final state as l = 1, l_z = -1, s = 1/2, s_z = -1/2.

title: Effective Magnetic Moment (Final State)
description: Important Criteria: The student should compute the effective magnetic moment of the final state as mu = -e*hbar/mc.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in calculating magnetic moments and probabilities.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Derivation Clarity
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide clear and logical steps in their derivations and reasoning.

title: Alternative Approaches
description: Optional Criteria: The student may explore alternative methods or checks to verify their results.
